result.question: Qual a distribuição de internações por raça/cor?
result.gold_sql: SELECT r."DESCRICAO" AS raca_cor, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN raca_cor r ON i."RACA_COR" = r."RACA_COR" GROUP BY r."DESCRICAO" ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC;
result.generated_sql: SELECT "RAÇA_COR", COUNT(*) AS "TOTAL_INTERNACOES" FROM internacoes GROUP BY "RAÇA_COR";
